name: OI-price divergence — new-shorts-at-lows bottom fade (price down + OI up, long, 4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: the mirror of the short-covering fade. A price DROP CONFIRMED by RISING open_interest means fresh SHORTS are entering at the lows — a crowded new-short book that becomes squeeze fuel, so the drop fades and we fade it LONG (direction +1). Signal: negative 4h return (price down) while open_interest expands (OI up) in a non-trending regime (low ADX so it is a range flush, not a real breakdown). The other side is late shorts piling in at the bottom vs the contrarian who buys the exhaustion. Hold ~0.25-0.5d on SPOT. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if OI is too noisy/aggregated at 4h so the divergence sign is unreliable — a PIT-honest single-venue OI series is required. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if the long fade underperforms same-bar momentum continuation (i.e. the drop just keeps going and OI-up adds nothing), or if edge dies once real taker fees hit the turnover.
catalyst: price falls while open interest rises in a calm regime — fresh shorts at the lows to fade long.
